briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs shipping advanced models this month. Compute constraints and regulatory pressure mount while investment remains robust at $11.9B quarterly.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with improved reasoning; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; Google deployed Gemini 3; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI and DeepSeek announced new variants. Model releases accelerated despite safety concerns.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp continues with TSMC securing additional capacity; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100-equivalent clusters; energy concerns delay two major US data center projects.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU meaningfully constrain frontier model scaling before 2027?
